_comment: Sibling of layout/pex-ring/pex.json, over layout/sampler_dff/'s own
assembled GDS instead of a ring -- extracts the fully-composed,
DRC-clean and klt lvs-clean sampler_dff GDS (real intra-cell
interconnect routing: rst_n/clk/clkb/mc/q/qb/s/m/mb all really wired,
not the ideal inter-leaf-cell wires layout/pex/sampler_dff_pex.spice's
leaf-cell composition assumes between the three leaf shapes) with
`klt extract --parasitics`, and rewrites the result the same way:
layout/bin/pex-netlist.py is shared, unmodified, between every
descriptor under layout/. See layout/pex-ring/README.md for why this
is a separate library rather than a rewrite of
layout/pex/sampler_dff_pex.spice -- the two measure different things
(per-leaf-cell composition with ideal inter-cell wires vs. one flat
extraction with real inter-cell wires) and swapping the netlist under
sim/post-layout-sampler-dff/'s existing records would make them
incomparable with what they were measured against.
This extraction was explicitly deferred until now: layout/sampler_dff/'s
own README (and spec/decision-records/DR-0007-*.md's own 'Follow-up
required' list) named 'm'/'mb' as the two data-path nets still unrouted
-- extracting the assembly flat before they closed would have extracted
an incomplete circuit. Both are now routed (mb: PR #95; m: PR #99,
issue #22) and layout/sampler_dff/'s own klt lvs is a full match (22/22
devices, 14/14 nets, 0 mismatches) against design/sampler_core.spice's
own flat `.subckt sampler_dff` -- see layout/sampler_dff/README.md.
Same field contract as layout/pex/pex.json -- see that file's own
_comment block. cells[].ports for sampler_dff_assembled_pex is
design/sampler_core.spice's own `.subckt sampler_dff d clk rst_n q vdd
vss` port order; m/mb/mc/s/qb/clkb are internal-to-the-cell nets kept
local by pex-netlist.py's wrapper, the same way ro_ring5's n1-n4/py
already are in layout/pex-ring/pex.json. ro_buf_pex is duplicated here
(same GDS as layout/pex/pex.json's own ro_buf_pex entry, and as
layout/pex-ring/pex.json's own copy) so this library is self-contained
for a testbench that .includes only @@PEX_LIB@@ plus
design/sampler_core.spice -- avoiding a same-subckt-name collision from
.include-ing more than one pex library in one deck.
